messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "increase to 100 mg orally once a day for type 2 diabetic nephropathy patients requiring titration"
set: ["increase to 100 mg orally once a day for type 2 diabetic nephropathy patients requiring titration", "increase to 100 mg orally once a day for hypertensive patients with left ventricular hypertrophy requiring titration", "increase to 100 mg orally three times a day after 3 days", "take orally once a day", "increase to 300 mg orally once a day after 4 days (extended-release tablets)", "8 mg taken orally 2 times a day", "do not exceed 100 mg a day for children 2 to 12 years", "take 40 mg orally once a day for up to 8 weeks", "initial dose 10 mg orally once a day", "maintenance dose 10 to 20 mg orally once a day", "study (n=54) took 40 mg orally once a day", "if 300 mg orally per day not tolerated, reduce to 150 mg once a day", "increase to 150 mg orally twice a day after 3 days (sustained-release tablets)", "usual starting dose for edema is 100 mg a day", "once a day", "taper dose to 150 mg once a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
